**Context.** Prof. Sehoon Ha's lab, Georgia Tech. Jan 2026 – present.

**Pipeline.** Capture a scene with a phone → COLMAP poses → 2D Gaussian Splatting →
mesh extraction → SAPIEN/ManiSkill (CoACD convex decomposition, auto-generated URDF).
The same splats are swapped into Isaac Lab via USD for policy training, and the trained
grasping policies are deployed on a Neuromeka NAMI mobile dual-arm platform with Zenoh
messaging.

**Hardware.** Neuromeka NAMI, Unitree Z1 / G1 (developer workflows, DDS control).

**Status.** Pipeline is end-to-end; quantitative sim-to-real results are being finalized.
